stem: A business moved from the €60 Business Care plan to the €40 plan during the 12-month window and is still subscribed. How does it count in the gross revenue retention for that window?

options.text: Not at all, since only cancelled businesses lower GRR
At €0 in the end MRR, as a business that was lost
At €40 in the end MRR, against €60 in the start MRR
At €60 in both, since GRR caps each business at its start MRR
